dimensions.name: Bearing face to braking plane
dimensions.physical_gate: Measure >=0.20 mm on both assembled rotor halves before tightening brake; no washer contact with bearing faces.

dimensions.name: S1 guide metal clamp stack
dimensions.physical_gate: 0.5 mm steel washer directly on 1.6 mm plain M2 nut; no PLA between them. Captured stack has nominal 0.20 mm total axial clearance. Do not substitute a 3 mm nyloc nut.

dimensions.name: Liner retainer pocket floor
dimensions.physical_gate: No broken layers or white stress marks when lightly seated.

dimensions.name: W cup-to-bridge adjustment gap each side
dimensions.physical_gate: Limit inward travel to <=0.20 mm per side measured from loose assembled position; match both sides within 0.10 mm.

dimensions.name: Guide slot minus pin diameter
dimensions.physical_gate: Must move freely without filing the metal shoulder or forcing the slot; record cross-axis play.

dimensions.name: Shaft end float
dimensions.physical_gate: Blind bores retain the 45 mm rod even before radial clamps engage; ends deburred.

dimensions.name: Ball magnet chamber axial allowance
dimensions.physical_gate: D8x3 dummy/magnet seats wholly inside; split faces must close without clamping on the magnet.

scope: Named part insertion paths and geometric keep-outs. Nut insertion into open split ball is provided by the open X=0 face. Does not replace actual tool access, elastic contact, fit or force tests.
